name: Might icon (SS)
description: Shape Survivors passive icon: up-arrow (triangle + stem). Port of i_might (BootScene.ts:574-576). Rim is `$venom.dark`, the same as `ss.icon.drone`: this passive is the Broodling evolution's other half, so the pair reads as a pair on the bar, in the green of the solutions the two are drawn from on the level-up. The glyph wears the rim's colour as well, so the passive is one colour on the bar.
